# PureLifePartner

> PureLifePartner (purelifepartner.com) is a global marriage website for people of every religion and background, anywhere in the world, who are seeking a life partner. Members create a free profile, browse and search verified marriage profiles in any country or city, and contact each other once both are verified. Profiles are private by default, real names and phone numbers are never shown publicly, and families can be involved.

Key facts:
- Type: matrimonial service (online marriage website and marriage bureau)
- Audience: single, divorced and widowed people of every religion worldwide seeking marriage, and their families
- Coverage: worldwide; members can search by any country or city, and by religion
- Free to join; verification is a paid one-off step confirmed by an admin, usually within 24 hours
- Fees can be paid in GBP, PKR, EUR or USD
- Contact details are released only when both members are verified
- Members can limit photos and video to verified members only
- Human support by WhatsApp (+44 7748 528207) and email
